human_understanding_delta: The old m-1 energy threshold was not intrinsic. The tail resultant is coefficient-explicit: for q=gcd(s,m-r), S=s/q, D=(m-r)/q, its squared modulus is |c|^(2r)|(-a)^S b^D-(-c)^D|^(2q).
